mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_chunk_stage WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.insert: WITH staged AS ( DELETE FROM kb_chunk_stage WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId} AND attempt_id = CAST(#{attemptId} AS uuid) AND create_time >= statement_timestamp() - interval '24 hours' RETURNING id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model ) INSERT INTO kb_chunk (id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model) SELECT id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model FROM staged

WITH source AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model, create_time FROM kb_chunk WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId} ), saved AS ( INSERT INTO kb_index_previous (tenant_code, doc_id, version_id, content_snapshot, chunk_count) SELECT tenant_code, doc_id, CAST(#{versionId} AS uuid), #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, count(*) FROM source GROUP BY tenant_code, doc_id RETURNING tenant_code, doc_id ) INSERT INTO kb_index_previous_chunk (id, tenant_code, doc_id, chunk_no, content, char_count, token_count, embedding, embedding_model, create_time) SELECT c.id, c.tenant_code, c.doc_id, c.chunk_no, c.content, c.char_count, c.token_count, c.embedding, c.embedding_model, c.create_time FROM source c JOIN saved USING (tenant_code, doc_id)
mapper.select: SELECT version_id::text AS version_id, content_snapshot, chunk_count FROM kb_index_previous WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId}
SELECT version_id::text AS version_id, chunk_count FROM kb_index_previous WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_index_previous WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND doc_id = #{docId}
